# get the amount of first person take rock paper scissors as r1 s1 p1 as follow

    # find mix win

    secondperson.append(secondperson[0])

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));

        // Read number of rounds (not used in calculation)
        String line = br.readLine();
        if (line == null) return;
        int round = Integer.parseInt(line.trim());

        // Read first person's counts
        StringTokenizer st1 = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int[] first = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            first[i] = Integer.parseInt(st1.nextToken());
        }

        // Read second person's counts
        StringTokenizer st2 = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int[] second = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            second[i] = Integer.parseInt(st2.nextToken());
        }

        // Calculate maximum wins for first person
        int maxWins = Math.min(first[0], second[1])   // rock vs scissors
                    + Math.min(first[1], second[2])   // scissors vs paper
                    + Math.min(first[2], second[0]);  // paper vs rock

        // Calculate minimum wins for first person
        int[] f = first.clone();
        int[] s = second.clone();

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            // Match with same type (draw)
            int diff = Math.min(f[i], s[i]);
            f[i] -= diff;
            s[i] -= diff;

            // If still left, match with type that beats them
            if (f[i] > 0) {
                int next = (i + 1) % 3;
                diff = Math.min(f[i], s[next]);
                f[i] -= diff;
                s[next] -= diff;
            }
        }

        int minWins = f[0] + f[1] + f[2];

        System.out.println(minWins + " " + maxWins);
    }
}
